citations.claim: Cart starts at edge of allowed initial range moving outward
Cart approaches track end with outward velocity
First violation: cart exceeds 2.4m track limit

explanation: Starting from x=0.5 with outward v=0.5, the state-feedback controller applies only ~0.5N (far below 40N limit) and never reverses the outward drift, so cart position monotonically increases until it exits the 2.4m track at step 95 while pole remains upright. Likely controller gains prioritize pole angle over cart position recovery for this light-cart/heavy-pole/high-gravity plant.

violation.detail: cart at x=2.405 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The cart sits at the far right edge of the track while the pole remains nearly upright. From step 92 to 95 the cart drifts further right with no reversal, reaching the boundary at step 95.
